steps.say: For tenancies of two years or more, the agreement lets either side bring the tenancy to an end early. The tenant uses three months notice, while the landlord has separate dated break routes.

On the timeline months run from the start. The tenant cannot give notice in the first three months, so the earliest exit is after six months. The landlord has a one-off break at six months. If a receiver is appointed, either side must wait four months then give at least two months. To sell, the landlord gives an intent notice after two months, then a break notice within four months, ending at least four months after the first notice and two months after the break notice.
